name: ssh-tmux-termination-baseline
purpose: Measure whether a remote SSH/tmux process survives app termination and whether the controller can reconnect with a truthful transcript after relaunch
steps: Start a unique tmux session with a remote heartbeat through the native SSH PTY
Terminate the app process and wait for the configured interval
Relaunch the app, reopen the preview and wait for a fresh terminal.ssh.ready event
Verify a new heartbeat marker is visible after each relaunch
